package store

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// The inner literal here spells no type of its own: it is elided, inferred from the enclosing
// []*pgx.QueuedQuery element type, so its lit.Type is nil and a check that required lit.Type to
// name QueuedQuery skipped it entirely -- and the batch ran hand-built, unscoped SQL.
func WidenElided(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, dyn string) {
	pool.SendBatch(ctx, &pgx.Batch{QueuedQueries: []*pgx.QueuedQuery{{SQL: dyn}}})
}
